newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean firms jointly buy 52,500 tonnes of corn.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean firms jointly buy 52,500 tonnes of corn.

text.p: A group of South Korean feed milling companies, known as the Big Feed Mills, bought 52,500 tonnes of corn from Japanese trading house Mitsui & Company Ltd, traders said on Friday.
Arrival was set by September 30 to the western ports of Inchon and Kunsan, they said.
Traders said the purchase was made at $133.92 a tonne C&F if sourced from the Pacific Northwest, at $132.92 a tonne C&F if from the U.S. Gulf or at $128.92 a tonne C&F if from China.
Shipment was set for August 27-September 15 if from the Pacific Northwest, for August 12-31 if from the U.S. Gulf or for September 11-30 if from China.
The premium for port rotation was set at $2.70 a tonne, they added.
